ledger.x: 1900 BCE: the Yueshi culture replaces the Longshan in Shandong.
1900 BCE: the Yueshi reaches eastern Henan.
1900 BCE: north Jiangsu is drawn Yueshi from the start.
1500 BCE: the Yueshi culture ends, replaced by the Erligang culture.

certainty.note: A prehistoric culture known from its sites (more than 340 in Shandong); no frontier is documented and the eastern Henan and north Jiangsu limits are approximate discs.
